value.rationale: An elementary but nontrivial local-generator boundary modification collapses exponentially many reconfiguration components to a linear number. Complete global connectivity criteria, an exact component-size spectrum, and a structural no-extra-isolates theorem hold simultaneously for all n. The level statistic is classical, but its completeness as a cyclic-constrained reachability invariant is mathematically motivated and not a trivial numerical count.
